incidentbot: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/INC-4321 — Auto-escalation scheduled if unacked in 2m
ops-bot: [automated] primary oncall did not ack, escalating to secondary :arrow_up:
devon: Ack'd on PD, jumping in. Seeing 5xx spikes and tokenization timeouts on host inference-04
raj: I can't connect to host inference-04 via ssh, looks like CPU 100% on node n-gpu-12
sophie: grabbing logs from router: `kubectl logs -n hosted-inference router-6bffd -c envoy --tail=200`
raj: paste: `2026-03-17T01:12:03Z WARN kvcache eviction loop delayed` and repeated OOM killer entries
devon: Rolling restart of the router pods to clear stuck connections. Command: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/router -n hosted-inference`
maria: If restart doesn't clear, escalate to manager for approval to spin up extra dedicated capacity. Customer queue length is growing (frontline says ~200 requests waiting)
sophie: Restart started, 3/5 pods restarted, latency dropping a bit :eyes:
ops-bot: PagerDuty escalation: manager notified (maria) — second escalation fired due to delayed resolution
maria: I'm awake, on my way to the bridge. Authorize adding 2 GPU instances if autoscaler doesn't respond in 5m
devon: Autoscaler logs show failed scale up due to quota errors: `insufficient gpus in region-us-west-2`
raj: Workaround: re-route low-priority traffic to degraded-model variant. Applying routing rule now: `rewriter set traffic_split=0.9/0.1`
sophie: Routing change applied, queue dropped to ~40 in 90s, latency 95p improved from 3.2s -> 1.1s :thumbsup:
devon: Confirmed service healthy, monitoring shows error rate returning to baseline
maria: Great job. I'll open a follow-up incident for capacity quota and autoscaler fallback (RCA + action items)
devon: Marking incident resolved in PD: INC-4321 — reason: routing fallback + router restart mitigated impact
incidentbot: Incident resolved: INC-4321 — closed by devon. Duration ~28m
